content: Jellyfin/Plex UX: Plex merges 'Continue Watching' and 'Next Up' into one Up Next queue (episode cards with background/season/episode label); Jellyfin keeps them split, cited as its biggest UX complaint for years. Both support per-item watchlist; Jellyfin's is via a home-sections plugin. Users want ability to remove/hide individual items from continue-watching without marking watched.
